examples.coptic: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲍ ⲉϩⲣⲉⲛⲡⲓⲇ ⲛϣⲟ ϫⲉⲁⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲗⲟⲩⲏⲣ ⲙⲃⲓⲣ ⲉⲩⲙⲉϩ ⲛⲗⲁⲕϩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉ**ⲍ** .
examples.english: When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?' They told him, 'Seven.'

examples.english: ‹why› did you not fortify yourself and stand up and cast out seven tongues, saying ‘Thētf’ (seven ‹times›), O great one among the spirits,
examples.source: PCM 1.7: Love spell using Horus-Isis narrative charm

examples.coptic: ⲛⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ **ⲍ** ⲇⲉ ⲛⲥⲟⲛ ϧⲁⲧⲟⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓϩⲟⲩⲓⲧ ϭⲓⲥϩⲓⲙⲓ ⲛⲁϥⲙⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲭⲁϫⲣⲟϫ .
examples.english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

examples.english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
